author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Loop engineering is powerful; it will get you what you ask for if you burn enough tokens in one go.

After I got the result, I end up spending the time trying to figure out what had happened.   My brain cannot keep up with the loop.   The good old 2-3 hours stretch run is the right pace for my brain to keep up.

It is so tempting to just hand it in and move on to the next loop.
